## 更新内容

### 歌词缓存

- 找到的歌词会保存到磁盘。重启 Lyrider 或重播同一首歌时直接读取，不再重新查询各歌词源。
- 只保存质量合格的结果：带时间轴；开启翻译时，译文覆盖足够或歌词以中文为主。不合格或空的结果只在本次运行中保留 5 分钟，之后重新查询。
- 磁盘上的歌词不会自动过期。歌词源后来更新了歌词时，可以在设置中清除缓存。

### 封面缓存

- 播放页封面、模糊背景和任务栏封面会保存到磁盘，再次显示时直接读取，不再下载。
- 封面缓存总量超过 256 MB 时，自动删除最久没用的封面。

### 缓存设置

- 设置页「歌词与播放」分区新增「缓存位置」和「清除缓存」。
- 默认位置为 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Lyrider\lyrics-data`，封面保存在其中的 `artwork` 子文件夹。可点“更改”选择其他文件夹，点“恢复默认”换回默认位置，保存设置后生效。更换位置后从空缓存开始，旧位置的文件保持不动。
- 「清除缓存」显示歌词和封面合计的占用大小，清除时只删除 Lyrider 自己生成的缓存文件，所选文件夹中的其他文件不受影响。

## 安装与升级

下载 `Lyrider_1.6.2.0_x64.msix` 和 `Lyrider.cer`，仅支持 Windows 11 x64。首次安装前，将证书导入当前用户的“受信任人”存储，再安装 MSIX：

```powershell
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\Lyrider.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\CurrentUser\TrustedPeople
Add-AppxPackage .\Lyrider_1.6.2.0_x64.msix
```

已有版本使用同一证书签名时，可直接安装新 MSIX 升级。安装包包含 .NET、Windows App SDK 运行时和中英文资源。Cider 插件 `Lyrider-Cider-Plugin_1.0.0.zip` 与 v1.6.1 相同，已安装的无需更新。

## 验证

- Release 构建 0 警告 0 错误；逻辑及服务测试（Release）：376/376 通过，新增歌词与封面缓存测试。
- 任务栏控件测试（Release）：58/58 通过。
- 封面集成测试：播放页 7/7、任务栏 7/7 通过，新增“已缓存的封面不发起网络请求”用例。
- 实机测试：安装后播放时写入了歌词与封面缓存；设置页的更改位置、恢复默认、占用大小和清除缓存工作正常。重启后从磁盘读取由自动化测试覆盖。

## Changes in English

### Lyrics cache

- Found lyrics are now saved to disk. After restarting Lyrider or replaying a song, they load directly instead of querying the lyrics sources again.
- Only good results are saved: time-synced, and, with translation on, with enough translated lines or primarily Chinese lyrics. Other or empty results are kept for 5 minutes in the current session and then looked up again.
- Saved lyrics do not expire. If a source improves its lyrics later, clear the cache in Settings.

### Cover cache

- The player cover, blurred backdrop and taskbar cover are saved to disk and load from there the next time instead of downloading again.
- When covers take more than 256 MB, the least recently used ones are removed automatically.

### Cache settings

- Added "Cache location" and "Clear cache" to the Lyrics and playback section in Settings.
- The default location is `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Lyrider\lyrics-data`, with covers in its `artwork` subfolder. Use "Change" to pick another folder or "Reset" to return to the default; the change applies after saving. A new location starts with an empty cache and leaves the old files in place.
- "Clear cache" shows the combined size of lyrics and covers and deletes only the cache files Lyrider created, never other files in the chosen folder.

### Installation and verification

Download `Lyrider_1.6.2.0_x64.msix` and `Lyrider.cer` for Windows 11 x64. For a first installation, import the certificate into the current user's Trusted People store using the commands above, then install the MSIX. Existing installations signed with the same certificate can upgrade directly. The Cider plugin `Lyrider-Cider-Plugin_1.0.0.zip` is unchanged from v1.6.1.

The Release build had no warnings or errors. All 376 logic/service tests, including the new lyrics and cover cache tests, and all 58 taskbar widget tests passed. The cover integration tests passed 7/7 for the player and 7/7 for the taskbar, including a new check that cached covers make no network request. A live test confirmed that the installed app caches lyrics and covers during playback, and that changing the location, resetting it, showing the size and clearing the cache work in Settings. Loading from disk after a restart is covered by the automated tests.

Full changelog: [v1.6.1...v1.6.2](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.6.1...v1.6.2)
